verdict.rationale: Pipedream offers a first-party chat app at chat.pipedream.com where users can try Pipedream MCP. An AI there can call connected-app tools, such as sending Slack messages, on the user's behalf. It is framed as a demo or reference app built on Vercel's AI SDK rather than an assistant embedded in the product, and its delegation capabilities are not documented in depth. Missing for 10: a documented built-in assistant inside the core product, details on what tasks it can handle and how far, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
